 Summary
 Gboho scores deserved Coventry opener ; Barry nets twice in five minutes to give Toffees lead
 Visitors denied penalty after Tarkowski pulls Yirenkyi's hair 
 Everton would move into top five with a win
 Moyes equals record for games as Toffees boss with 592 
 Coventry have three wins in past five games

 Get involved Live Reporting
 Emlyn Begley
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 67 mins 67 mins 
 Everton 2-1 Coventry 
 Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall almost doubles Everton's lead but his curling effort from just outside the box is palmed wide by Carl Rushworth.
 55 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 66 mins 66 mins 
 Everton 2-1 Coventry 
 The game has calmed down a bit now. Everton with a decent spell of possession.
 117 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 65 mins 65 mins 
 Everton 2-1 Coventry 
 Coventry will barely be able to believe they are losing this. Two strong penalty shouts and then taking the lead but they've been Thierno Barried.
 243 108 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:22 GMT 21:22 GMT 
 Everton 2-1 Coventry 
 Image source, Getty Images Here's the stat you all wanted.
 Thierno Barry is now the second top scoring Barry in Premier League history (14), overtaking Barry Hayles (13) and behind only Gareth Barry (53).
 320 82 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'One of the scrappiest goals you will see' published at 21:21 GMT 21:21 GMT 
 Everton 2-1 Coventry 
 Lee Hendrie 
Former Aston Villa midfielder on Sky Sports 
 This is unbelievable, this is probably one of the scrappiest goals you will see.
 It's really, really scruffy.
 What a season Thierno Barry is having.
 265 81 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:21 GMT 21:21 GMT 
 Everton 2-1 Coventry 
 His first effort was saved by Carl Rushworth but he managed to get it over the line somehow. 
 I did think it was going to be disallowed for handball though.
 130 68 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:21 GMT 21:21 GMT 
 Everton 2-1 Coventry 
 The goal stands! 
 488 228 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Everton 2-1 Coventry published at 61 mins 61 mins 
 Thierno Barry 
 Image source, Getty Images The goal king!
 Thierno Barry is on double figures now for the season.
 But maybe he's handled the ball before bundling it over the line from close range.
 922 357 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:19 GMT 21:19 GMT 
 Everton 1-1 Coventry 
 Nick Mashiter 
BBC Sport football news reporter at the Hill Dickinson Stadium 
 Everton left the pitch at half time to muted boos, the atmosphere was taking a further turn as the home frustration grew - until Barry pounced. 
 It is a very different mood in the stadium now.
 .
 172 60 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 61 mins 61 mins 
 Everton 1-1 Coventry 
 Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall has a shot blocked. Tyler Dibling heads a cross down. Cleared.
 It really is end to end.
 86 13 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:19 GMT 21:19 GMT 
 Everton 1-1 Coventry 
 Only Erling Haaland (14) has scored more goals in all competitions this season than Thierno Barry (nine) among Premier League players.
 119 44 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 59 mins 59 mins 
 Everton 1-1 Coventry 
 It's turned into a great game now. Yann Gboho lays the ball off to Jack Rudoni, whose shot is deflected behind for a Coventry corner.
 104 53 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'If anyone can, Barry can' published at 21:18 GMT 21:18 GMT 
 Everton 1-1 Coventry 
 Lee Hendrie 
Former Aston Villa midfielder on Sky Sports 
 If anyone can, Thierno Barry can.
 Excellent play from Tyler Dibling initially before the goal.
 Little bit of movement from Barry. He just cushions that header home, Carl Rushworth has no chance whatsoever.
 It's a big goal. The reaction alone is massive and there is real energy about this place again.
 191 71 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:17 GMT 21:17 GMT 
 Everton 1-1 Coventry 
 Thierno Barry has scored nine goals in all competitions this season for Everton - one more than last season's final total.
 206 62 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Everton 1-1 Coventry published at 57 mins 57 mins 
 Thierno Barry 
 Image source, Getty Images Everton aren't behind for long. They swing a few crosses in and the last one - from Vitalii Mykolenko - finds Thierno Barry, who powers a header past Carl Rushworth. The keeper gets a touch but can't keep it out.
 1063 637 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:15 GMT 21:15 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' on this page to have your say 
 Great goal. Justice has been done.
 Kieran, Glasgow 
 Yann Gboho flick, well deserved.
 Peter, Coventry 
 144 150 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 56 mins 56 mins 
 Everton 0-1 Coventry 
 Lovely footwork from Yann Gboho, who is looking like some kind of skill king, but then his pass to Taiwo Awoniyi is poor.
 55 33 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:14 GMT 21:14 GMT 
 Everton 0-1 Coventry 
 No team have scored more Premier League goals in the first 15 minutes after half-time than Coventry (five) this season.
 147 52 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:13 GMT 21:13 GMT 
 Everton 0-1 Coventry 
 Coventry scream for yet another penalty - for what they say is a Harrison Armstrong handball. Not given and VAR quickly dismiss it.
 91 144 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Coventry probably deserve it' published at 21:13 GMT 21:13 GMT 
 Everton 0-1 Coventry 
 Lee Hendrie 
Former Aston Villa midfielder on Sky Sports 
 Image source, Getty Images A sheer bit of magic and class.
 Yann Gboho gets control and then he just slides it towards goal that makes it so special.
 Coventry probably deserve it.
